primitives.verbatim_quote: Any routine deletion, auto-purge, overwriting, archiving, or destruction policy that would affect the materials identified below must be suspended immediately as to those materials.

primitives.assumptions: Corporate systems possess programmable retention policies; administrative override authority exists.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur if automated cloud garbage collection operates outside local administrative control boundaries.

layer2.mapping: Derives a zero-derivative constraint on the information density field, ensuring no mass loss in the targeted ESI vector space.
